name: diyHue
author: diyHue
description: diyHue is an open-source emulator of the Philips Hue bridge. It lets you control a wide range of smart lights (Hue, Yeelight, Tasmota, ESPHome, WLED, MiLight and many more) from the official Hue app, Home Assistant, Alexa and Google Home without the original hardware bridge.

form_fields.label: MAC address
form_fields.pattern_error: Enter a valid MAC address (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
form_fields.hint: MAC address of the host network interface. Required to generate valid Hue certificates.
